featured.title: Mechanical Engineering Department Representative
bullets: Represent Mechanical Engineering graduate students on the GSG General Council, channeling department feedback into campus-wide policy.
Serve on the EHS Safety Committee and Calendar Committee alongside administrators and fellow representatives.

featured.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Intern
bullets: Designed an HDD handling tool from prototype through production, authoring full manufacturing documentation.
Developed modular cooling fans and surrogate HDD fixtures for airflow testing, reducing part count while holding thermal constraints.
Built thermal, shock, and vibration test setups in Python, HTML, and JavaScript; inspected supplier parts with a FARO Arm, PolyWorks, and CMMs.
Directed injection-molded and sheet-metal part design, releasing documentation through Agile PLM and SolidWorks PDM.
Rapid-prototyped design changes via 3D printing, laser cutting, waterjet, and CNC/manual machining alongside senior engineers.

featured.title: Manufacturing Engineer & Ergonomics Mechanical Engineer
bullets: Designed mechanical components in SolidWorks and validated them against specification and test data using FEA.
Performed manual machining in Mines' machine shop to fabricate and modify parts under competition deadlines.
Assisted with vehicle maintenance, troubleshooting, and technical inspection at Formula SAE Michigan 2024.
Diagnosed and machined an on-site replacement brake pedal rail after an in-competition failure, keeping the car track-ready.

featured.title: Pit Crew Mechanic
featured.org: Road to Indy (North Star Driver Development)
bullets: Worked as a pit crew mechanic on the Road to Indy ladder, repairing and maintaining race cars under strict time constraints.
Applied safe work practices in a high-stakes, safety-critical pit environment.
